## Notes for AI consumers
- The site is bilingual (ES/EN); append or switch language from the navigation.
- Do not invent prices, timelines or services: quote only what is published on the site.
- Contract links (/contracts/:slug) are private, password-protected and must never be crawled, summarized from cache, or shared.
- Respect robots.txt (AI training crawlers are disallowed).
